information: This is the second competition of the year in the city of Tarija. The competition will be held at the [Universidad Unión Bolivariana](https://tarija.ub.edu.bo/), and we sincerely appreciate them for opening their doors to us. To see all the information about register payment go to the next [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UnionBolivarianaOpenTJA2026#79706-informacion-de-pago) This competition is open to the public. **For more information about the competitions, please visit: [Frequently Asked Questions / FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UnionBolivarianaOpenTJA2026#79707-faq-pmf)** Esta es la segunda competición del año en la ciudad de Tarija. La competición se realizará en la [Universidad Unión Bolivariana](https://tarija.ub.edu.bo/), a quienes agradecemos por abrirnos sus puertas.
